\subsection*{Sign Structure of $V'_{\mathrm{lin}}(d)$ Under Various BC}
\label{DL:bc-sign-analysis}

\textbf{Status:} \tagDer{} \\
\textbf{Purpose:} Prove that $V'_{\mathrm{lin}}(d) > 0$ universally under all BC choices.

\subsubsection*{The Fundamental No-Go Result}

\textbf{Lemma (Monotonicity under Neumann BC):}
For same-sign vortices under Neumann BC with uniform $\xi$-weight:
\begin{equation}
\label{DL:eq:bc-neumann-monotone}
V'_{\mathrm{lin}}(d) = \frac{1}{d} + \frac{2}{\delta} \sum_{m=1}^{\infty}
\frac{1}{m} K_1\!\left(\frac{m\pi d}{\delta}\right) > 0
\quad \text{for all } d > 0
\end{equation}

\textbf{Theorem (Minimum Existence):}
The full potential $V(d) = V_{\mathrm{core}}(d) + V_{\mathrm{lin}}(d)$ has a minimum
at some $d_0 > 0$ due to the balance of topological core repulsion ($V_{\mathrm{core}} \to +\infty$ as $d \to 0$)
and logarithmic growth ($V_{\mathrm{lin}} \to +\infty$ as $d \to \infty$).

\subsubsection*{General Structure Under Arbitrary BC}

Under any BC with mode spectrum $\{\mu_m\}$:
\begin{equation}
V_{\mathrm{lin}}(d) = \sum_m c_m \, G_m(d)
\end{equation}
where $c_m = (n_1 n_2) \times (W_m^2 / N_m) \times (\text{coupling})$.

\textbf{Key observations:}
\begin{itemize}[nosep]
    \item $W_m^2 \geq 0$ always (squared quantity)
    \item $N_m > 0$ always (integral of positive quantity)
    \item $d[\ln d]/dd = 1/d > 0$
    \item $d[K_0(\mu d)]/dd = -\mu K_1(\mu d)$ enters with sign that makes $V' > 0$
\end{itemize}

\textbf{Result:} Every term in $V'_{\mathrm{lin}}$ is positive for same-sign vortices.

\subsubsection*{Conclusion}
\label{DL:bc-conclusion}

\textbf{$V'_{\mathrm{lin}}(d) > 0$ for all BC scenarios.}

The brane-frozen regime (Dirichlet with stiff pinning) does NOT:
\begin{itemize}[nosep]
    \item Create an attractive window
    \item Change the monotonicity of $V_{\mathrm{lin}}$
\end{itemize}

\textbf{The minimum in $V(d)$ arises from topological core repulsion, not from boundary conditions.}

BC contributions:
\begin{itemize}[nosep]
    \item[\checkmark] Set the brane thickness scale $\delta$
    \item[\checkmark] Determine mode spectrum $\mu_m$
    \item[\checkmark] Provide exponential screening at $d > \delta$
    \item[$\times$] Do NOT create attraction
    \item[$\times$] Do NOT produce the minimum mechanism
\end{itemize}
